claim: Every AAAI-26 main-track submission (22,977 full-review papers) received an AI-generated review from a multi-stage, tool-using frontier-model system, generated for all papers in under a day.
stance_target: scope of AI involvement in the AAAI review process
scope_conditions: AAAI-26 Main Track, first large-scale field deployment of AI-assisted peer review
quoted_support: every main-track submission at AAAI-26 received one clearly identified AI review from a state-of-the-art system... generate reviews for all 22,977 full-review papers in less than a day.

claim: AAAI-26 authors and program committee members preferred the AI-generated reviews to human reviews on technical accuracy and research-suggestion quality in a large-scale survey.
stance_target: AI reviews at AAAI are methodologically substantive, not decorative
quoted_support: participants not only found AI reviews useful, but actually preferred them to human reviews on key dimensions such as technical accuracy and research suggestions.
